title: Middleware Administrator
summary: Installs, configures and keeps running the application servers (WebLogic, WebSphere, JBoss, Tomcat) and web servers that business Java applications run on. Sits in the infrastructure or operations team, handling deployments, certificates, patches and production issues for application teams.
dailyDuties: Deploy application releases to WebLogic, WebSphere or JBoss servers
Renew SSL certificates and update keystores
Apply server patches and upgrades in change windows
Take thread and heap dumps to troubleshoot slow or hung apps
Configure Apache, IHS or Nginx proxies and load balancing
Automate routine tasks with WLST, Jython or shell scripts
Work incident and change tickets in the ITSM tool

skills.expectation: Run at least one Java application server in production

Configure Apache, IHS, Nginx or Tomcat as web and proxy tiers
Generate CSRs, renew SSL certificates and maintain keystores
Work daily on Linux or Unix servers to read logs and manage processes
Automate deployments, restarts and health checks with shell scripts
Read thread and heap dumps and tune JVM settings
Handle incidents and change requests through ITIL processes
Script admin tasks in Python or Jython
Automate installs and configuration with Ansible or similar tools
Watch application health with Dynatrace or AppDynamics
Read Java stack traces and understand how applications are packaged
Hook deployments into Jenkins or similar pipelines
Support containerised Java apps on Kubernetes or OpenShift
